premium.basis: Based on the Value Inflection Points table showing a +21.3% change from the pre-event close of $163.73 to the post-event close of $198.55 for the week ended 2015-04-10.

value_inflection_events.event: Mylan publicly announces the Initial Proposal.

leaked_early.details: The initial approach was made on April 6, 2015, and publicly announced by Mylan on April 8, 2015. There is no evidence of a press report or rumor circulating a month or more before the official announcement.

notes: The deal was an unsolicited, hostile tender offer that was ultimately terminated after failing to gain sufficient shareholder support, leading to the resignation of Perrigo's CEO.
